randomSeedPolicy: LCG, per emitter constructor node count * 373 + prefab name length * 131; initial seeds in source/particle-parameters.json
finishPolicy: Preserve particle lifetimes after emission ends; 0.5/1.5 trigger delay is not used as hard cut. Source ParticleEffect runtime Stop/Finish lifecycle not emulated.

rendering.method: offline OpenGL 3.3 shader transcription with original textures, original mesh geometry or canonical billboard quads
rendering.formula: Color = selectedTextureChannels * materialTint * particleColor * 2; original shader dissolve/disturb, ST, per-particle CustomData and FxUVRotation applied where active.
rendering.additive: Coverage-converted combined straight RGBA. Raw un-clipped float RGB retained in layers/additive-energy.zip. Original SrcAlpha/One additive cannot be exactly represented by ordinary alpha over every background.

validation.visuallyInspected: Peak render on both dark/light backgrounds and contact sheets, sprites visible. Not Unity or DST runtime comparison.

approximations: Source-driven particle simulation is not Unity runtime playback. Shape Box, Hermite curves, Color/Size/Rotation, UV sheet, velocity clamp and CustomData are translated.
Unity particle noise is approximated by fixed seeded smooth value noise; trajectories/random sampling differ from Unity.
Particle limit capped at 512 by simulator for original 1000-cap emitters; observed alive counts stay below this cap.
Velocity clamp damping uses fixed-step approximation; Unity native update ordering and random channel independence are not verified.
No Unity scene depth/soft particle intersection, HDR bloom, color grading or dynamic target silhouette.
2D orthographic projection and painter sorting approximate the original gameplay camera.
disabledLayer: static_offset/rotation_y has disabled Renderer and Emission; true Default-Particle material resolved from anon CAB967, retained as source only.
